# Gaano Ka Adda (गानों का अड्डा) 🎵

> The ultimate Indian music hangout spot - Immersive, scenic Indian audio and era-based musical experiences spanning 90s Village Nostalgia, 2000s Bollywood Romance, Highway Truck Vibes, Action Cinema, Late Night Road Trips, Bollywood Lo-Fi, and High-Energy Phonk.

## 🌟 Musical Experience Modules

- [ट्रैक्टर वाला (Tractor Waala)](/): 90s Indian Village Nostalgia with authentic retro radio player, scenic rural visuals, ambient atmospheric particles, interactive tractor rev audio, and real-time listeners counter.
- [सदाबहार 2000s (Bollywood Romance)](/2000s): 69 iconic Bollywood romantic classics from 90s to 2000s (DDLJ, KKHH, Mohabbatein, Veer-Zaara, Jab We Met, Kal Ho Naa Ho) with falling rose petals.
- [ट्रक वाला (Highway Express)](/truck): 54 classic highway road trip anthems with dynamic motion video, interactive "Horn OK Please" sound effects, and authentic truck shayari.
- [धुरंधर (Action Cinema)](/dhurandhar): 29 high-octane tracks from Dhurandhar Part 1 & 2 by Shashwat Sachdev, featuring cinematic visual, fiery ember particle engine, and iconic dialogue rotation.
- [लॉन्ग ड्राइव (Late Night Road Trip)](/long-drive): 52 classic road trip and late-night highway anthems (Ilahi, Iktara, Dil Dhadakne Do, Ik Junoon, Dil Chahta Hai, Amplifier) with midnight cyan light streak effects.
- [लो-फाई लव (Bollywood Lofi)](/lofi): 30 soul-soothing slowed and reverb Bollywood love songs (Tera Chehra, Hawayein, Ishq Sufiyana, Samjhawan, Sanam Re, Galliyan) with dreamy pastel anime visual and floating cherry blossom petals.
- [PHONK / FUNK (Brazilian Phonk & Drift)](/phonk): 23 high-voltage viral Brazilian Phonk and drift funk anthems (LUZ ROJA, Montagem Vozes Talentinho, FUNK CRIMINAL, GOZALO, Montagem Bailão) with dark neon drift anime scenes and electric crimson flares.

## 🛠️ Technology Stack

- Framework: Next.js (App Router, Turbopack)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS & Vanilla CSS
- Animations: Framer Motion & Canvas Particle Engine
- Audio & Media: YouTube IFrame API Controller & Web Audio API Synth Engine
- State & Realtime: React Hooks & Organic Active Presence Engine
